E3627

Replay capture refused sensitive data

What

Replay capture refused sensitive data

Why

Safe capture refuses reachable Rand/IO/Net; sensitive capture needs TTY consent.

Fix

use `--capture` for Time-only, or run `--capture-sensitive` interactively.
